card.name: Plain words in patient-education explanations
card.fires_on: Ordinary connecting or filler words (to, are, and, other, a) inside simple patient-handout sentences describing a test, fluid, or symptom. Typical settings are spina bifida, amniocentesis, wound care and side effects.

modes.label: Linking words in procedure descriptions
modes.description: Small words such as 'are', 'helps' or 'material' in plain-language explanations of tests and fluids.
modes.example: A few teaspoons of amniotic fluid<< are>> withdrawn in the needle.

modes.label: Small words in symptom or treatment lists
modes.description: Words like 'to', 'other' or 'a' in simple sentences about symptoms or switching medicine.
modes.example: In many cases, there are no<< other>> symptoms.
